name: cmdhelp
description: 命令行智能助手：npx cmdhelp <命令名>，基于本地 man/Get-Help 帮助文档 + AI 生成通俗中文解释

scripts.binary: npm run build && pkg dist/cli.js --targets node18-win-x64,node18-linux-x64 --output dist/bin/cmdhelp
scripts.binary:win: npm run build && pkg dist/cli.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/bin/cmdhelp.exe
scripts.binary:linux: npm run build && pkg dist/cli.js --targets node18-linux-x64 --output dist/bin/cmdhelp-linux
